substeps.caption: A bed slinger: the bed moves front to back, the toolhead left to right along the arm, and the arm up and down the column.
Printing a small vial rack in PLA: the head and the bed trace each layer between them, and the arm climbs a layer at a time as the part grows.
The magnetic PEI plate lifts off with the rack on it: the arm takes the plate, not the part.
The arm parks, ready for a fresh plate.
